environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an AWS Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (no additional rule groups). Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0 forwarded to port 8080. The ALB has access logging enabled to S3 but no active rule-based filtering. The application runs as a systemd service under a non-root user with Python 3.9 and Flask 2.3. SQLite database stored at /var/data/users.db with file permissions 0644.

config.alb_rules: default forward action only, no WAF association
